tools.name: search_properties
tools.description: Search Florida listings through IDX Broker. Provide community OR zipcode (zipcode overrides community). listingIds overrides every filter except sort. Sort 'pra' requires mip; sort 'sqfta' requires sqft. Returns up to 25 results by default plus a searchURL to share with the client.
